newsitem.title: UK: UK's Heseltine says low inflation set to continue.
newsitem.headline: UK's Heseltine says low inflation set to continue.

text.p: Britain's Deputy Prime Minister Michael Heseltine said on Wednesday that economic conditions in the country were ripe for a low inflationary environment to continue.

"The inflation figures in this country today are low and are set to remain low," Heseltine told a news conference. "The important thing...is to see real income rising, financed by productivity gains. And that is what has been happening."
Heseltine also said Britain's economy would post the fastest growth in western Europe over the next two years coupled with rising real living standards.

"That is the benign circumstance in which a well-run economy is delivering not only the fastest growth this year, next year and the year after in Western Europe but is delivering rising real standards coupled with tax reduction."
